title: [Latest DEV] Request: Backfill BG values with "grey" color?
symptom: After replacing the sensor, a straight line is created from the last BG value before sensor removal to the new value after two warm-up hours. These values are not real BG readings and the user requests they be displayed in grey or another color.
fix: The feature was implemented in a commit, as confirmed by MilosKozak.
